briefing: Markets were quietly mixed today with NASDAQ +0.5% and S&P 500 +0.2% — not the strong risk-on signal needed to deploy new capital. Cash on hand ($389.29) sits below the $500 buy threshold anyway, so we're holding all 7 positions and waiting for a clearer setup rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was below the minimum buy threshold and the market showed only neutral momentum, so holding cash rather than forcing a trade preserves flexibility for a better setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指投資者保留在場邊、隨時可動用的現金,以便在真正出現強勢機會時把握時機。今日現金餘額低於最低買入門檻,加上市況僅屬中性,因此保留現金、不勉強交易,能為日後更佳的入市時機保留彈性。

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted modestly higher today without a clear catalyst, reflecting a market in wait-and-see mode. With gains under 1% on both NASDAQ and S&P 500, there wasn't enough conviction in either direction to justify new positioning. Days like this are common between larger macro events and are best used to stay patient rather than chase small moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市溫和上揚,納指升0.5%,標普500升0.2%,沒有明顯的市場催化劑,反映投資者處於觀望狀態。兩大指數升幅均不足1%,方向性不夠明確,不足以支持新增部位。這類淡靜交易日在重大宏觀事件之間頗為常見,最好保持耐性,而非追逐細微波動。
